description: Send the merchant a chat ping on every sale — plus rebills, refunds, failed renewals (dunning) and cancellations — to Slack, Discord or Telegram. Credentials are validated live (a test message is posted) and stored encrypted. Slack & Discord: create an incoming webhook and pass its webhook_url. Telegram (bring-your-own-bot): the merchant makes a bot via @BotFather for a bot_token and passes their chat_id. This is a PAID-PLAN (Pro) feature — on a free plan it returns a plan_required error; tell the seller to upgrade rather than retrying.

chat_id.description: Telegram chat ID to post into
